test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states are situated on the Bangladesh border?

options.text: Sikkim, Nagaland, Meghalaya, West Bengal, Mizoram
Mizoram, Tripura, Sikkim, Manipur, West Bengal
West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram
West Bengal, Assam, Sikkim, Nagaland, Meghalaya

solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram** are the Indian states that share a border with Bangladesh.
 
• These states have significant geographical, cultural, and economic interactions with Bangladesh.
 
• The **India-Bangladesh border** is one of the longest international borders in the world, stretching over 4,096 kilometers.
 
• This border is crucial for bilateral trade, security, and cross-border cooperation between India and Bangladesh.
 
• Border management and security are key concerns for both countries due to issues such as illegal immigration, smuggling, and border disputes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indo-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement** was signed in 2015 to resolve longstanding border disputes and facilitate better management of the border.
 
• Several border haats (markets) have been established to promote trade and economic cooperation between border communities of both countries.
 
• The border areas are often characterized by diverse ethnic communities with rich cultural heritages.
 
• Cross-border initiatives have been undertaken to enhance infrastructure, connectivity, and people-to-people exchanges.
 
• The border regions are also important for environmental conservation, with several transboundary rivers and ecosystems.
